name: Controlled Traffic Expansion Decision
decisionRules: repeat_same_tiny_step is allowed only when M83 selected repeat_tiny_step, evidence is GO and all risk counts are zero.
prepare_private_review_packet is allowed only when M83 selected prepare_next_private_review, evidence is GO and all risk counts are zero.
hold_for_fix is allowed when M83 selected hold_for_fix or the monitor is blocked without sales pause risk.
pause_sales is required when refunds, claims issues, incidents or paused monitor evidence are present.
continue_observation is allowed only when no risk is present and the operator chooses not to move traffic yet.
